tools.name: list_analysis_contexts
tools.description: List the contexts and analysis profiles admitted for the configured API key.

tools.name: submit_case_analysis
tools.description: Submit one case analysis with an explicit context, immutable S3 input, cost ceiling and idempotency key.

CostDecimal.x-semantic-validator: decimal value <= 9223372036854775807; convert exactly to API StrictInt

IdempotencyKey.description: Exact printable ASCII operation key, 1..200 characters; first and last characters are non-space. Internal spaces are preserved. Reuse the original key after interruption.

tools.name: get_case_analysis_status
tools.description: Read the current analysis stage, outcome, sequencing review and billing state.

tools.name: acknowledge_sequencing_qc_review
tools.description: Record an explicit acknowledgement of the exact sequencing QC review receipt.

tools.name: request_sequencing_analysis_cancellation
tools.description: Request cancellation of sequencing analysis and return its current state.

tools.name: get_case_analysis_result_manifest
tools.description: Read and verify the published analysis result manifest.

tools.name: download_analysis_result_file
tools.description: Verify an original result file and return its protected API download URL. Fetch it with the same Bearer API key.

tools.name: get_analysis_export_summary
tools.description: Read the frozen export summary, coverage and collection availability.

tools.name: get_analysis_export_schema
tools.description: Describe the frozen export fields, exact numeric encoding and supported query operators.

tools.name: get_analysis_export_provenance
tools.description: Read the recorded clinical profile, source hashes, classifier and export identities.

tools.name: get_analysis_export_variant
tools.description: Read one exact generation-local variant record from the frozen export.

tools.name: query_analysis_export_records
tools.description: Filter, sort, project and page one collection in a verified frozen analysis export.

tools.name: get_analysis_export_gene_records
tools.description: Page one frozen export collection for an exact source gene symbol.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List cases linked to this machine principal's accepted Partner API commands in one selected context; optional literal case-name search.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Read the operational header and latest partner-command summary of one machine-owned case in the selected context.

tools.name: list_case_analyses
tools.description: Page compact accepted partner-command history for one machine-owned case; this is not native reanalysis/execution history.

tools.name: list_source_connections
tools.description: List the selected context's currently admitted S3 root grants, preserving source order and duplicates; no provider browsing or health check.

tools.name: browse_source_objects
tools.description: Browse one level of explicitly permitted S3 sources and select an actual immutable file version.
